{"requirements": [
  {"id": 1, "text": "The goal of the game is to complete 33 levels successfully."},
  {"id": 2, "text": "The board is 200 pixels wide horizontally and 300 pixels wide vertically."},
  {"id": 3, "text": "The bricks and the paddle are rectangular blocks with a width of 20 pixels and height of 10 pixels. The ball has a diameter of 10 pixels."},
  {"id": 4, "text": "At the beginning of each level, the ball starts from the top left corner of the board and moves downwards with a straight trajectory at a 45° angle and a speed of 5 pixels per second."},
  {"id": 5, "text": "The user moves a paddle in order to hit a ball, making it change its direction upward."},
  {"id": 6, "text": "To successfully complete a level, the user needs to break all bricks."},
  {"id": 7, "text": "Bricks can have a color (blue, red, gold) and can be sized single or double."},
  {"id": 8, "text": "A brick is sized either 20 x 10 pixels or 60 x 10 pixels."},
  {"id": 9, "text": "Blue bricks are destroyed with one hit, red bricks require two hits, gold bricks require three hits."},
  {"id": 10, "text": "The first level gets initialised with 50 blue, single bricks that are placed in the brick section of the board."},
  {"id": 11, "text": "The paddle only moves horizontally on the bottom of the board, controlled by the user by left and right arrow keys. The paddle cannot go outside the board. When each level starts the paddle resets to the center of the bottom border."},
  {"id": 12, "text": "The ball direction changes every time the ball hits the paddle or the border of the board (except for the bottom border) with the correct angle of reflection."},
  {"id": 13, "text": "Every time the next level starts, the speed of the ball increases by 1 pixel per second."},
  {"id": 14, "text": "When the user finishes a level, the next level with a different brick arrangement and increased difficulty begins. Each level removes two red bricks and one gold brick."},
  {"id": 15, "text": "The brick pattern and arrangement is randomly generated by the program."},
  {"id": 16, "text": "The user is given 3 lives."},
  {"id": 17, "text": "The user loses a life every time the ball falls off the side of the board."},
  {"id": 18, "text": "When the user loses a life but still has lives remaining, the level restarts. Once the user loses all lives, the game is over."},
  {"id": 19, "text": "When a game is over, it can be started again from level 1 or ended."}
] }
